name: test-runner-b1-runner-skeleton-manifest
title: B1: in-house parallel smoke runner skeleton + manifest format + test:all entry
description: B1 of the test-runner consolidation sub-program. Per the A0 decision doc (B-35aa: docs/requirements/decisions/test-runner-consolidation-plan.md): build the in-house parallel smoke runner skeleton at packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes.ts that scans packages/main/src/tasks/*-smoke.ts (currently 153 files / ~71,244 lines), spawns smokes in parallel (default = os.cpus().length workers), reads a manifest at packages/main/smoke-manifest.json controlling per-smoke timeout and optional tags, and supports --tag <tag> + --select <pattern> filters. Add `test:all` npm script at root. The 262 existing individual `test:*` scripts (113 root + 149 packages/main) are LEFT UNCHANGED in this story (B2 collapses them separately). Acceptance per the A0 doc: `npm run test:all` runs every smoke in parallel and reports per-smoke pass/fail + aggregate summary; running with --tag/--select filters; existing individual test:* scripts are untouched.
